title: std::basic_stacktrace<Allocator>::~basic_stacktrace
summary: Destructs the basic_stacktrace. The destructors of the std::stacktrace_entry objects it holds are called and the used storage is deallocated.
html:
~basic_stacktrace();
 (since C++23)

Destructs the basic_stacktrace. The destructors of the std::stacktrace_entry objects it holds are called and the used storage is deallocated.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the basic_stacktrace.
